messages:
maria: FYI seeing steady memory growth + paging storms on long-context runs with PagedAttention. H100 and MI250x both exhibit issues but with different failure modes.
ajay: can you share exact run config? batch/seq/flags?
maria: batch=8 seq=8192 ENABLE_PAGED_KV=1 run_local. After ~5-8m latency spikes, evict storms, host mmio waits.
kevin: paste telemetry and kernel-selection log lines if you have them.
maria: telemetry excerpt: 
```
kvcache.evictions/sec=140
kvcache.pagefaults/sec=1120
kvcache.reuse-rate=0.09
kernel.selection=flash-attn:fp16->fallback:paged-attn:quantized
```
Also dmesg shows repeated "GPU page fault remap failed" entries.
chiara: MI250x traces point to page-table fragmentation and expensive remap walks; ROCm coalescing is exposing a PT shuffle that we don't hit on CUDA frequently.
ajay: hypothesis: allocator reuse races with PT clear path. If freed page is reallocated before the PT metadata is fully removed, we reintroduce stale mappings.
kevin: that fits a stale-check failure pattern. Any debug-allocator trace?
maria: ran debug build with ENABLE_PT_DEBUG=1; relevant lines: 
```
PT_OP remap start id=0x1b7
PT_OP remap end id=0x1b7 status=OK
PT_OP free id=0x0f stale-check=fail
ALLOC freed 0x0f -> reused 0x0f before pt_clear
```
kevin: confirmed. Need a fence between pt_clear and allocator reuse or a delayed-free queue. Also the PT update path needs stronger ordering on PCIe topologies.
chiara: on MI250x, DMA scatter path and the allocator fastpath can reinsert pages quickly; adding a small epoch delay solved a repro locally (but is hacky).
ajay: quick mitigation idea: for very long sequences (seq>4k) prefer contiguous KV slabs (KV_ALLOC_STRATEGY=contig) to reduce remap churn. Trade memory for fewer remaps.
maria: tried contig strategy: evicts/sec dropped from ~130 to ~20 and tail latency stabilized; memory used +18%.
kevin: good temporary mitigation. For a proper fix I'll prototype delayed-free queue plus an in-driver epoch/fence to avoid host roundtrips.
chiara: also recommend adding a ROCm-specific CI job that runs a long-context paged-kv test on MI250x to catch regressions.
infra-bot: CI job kvcache-debug-build failed on MI250x test_kv_eviction (segfault in test harness) - see CI link.
ajay: segfault probably from debug assert hitting reused page; expected while reproducing.
kevin: I'll open a PR after branching; includes allocator change + PT fencing + unit test harness to reproduce PT shuffle.
maria: created issue #1257 (paged-kv: PT remap->allocator reuse race (H100/MI250x)) and uploaded traces + nvprof/rocprof + dmesg excerpts. Assigning to kevin/chiara.
kevin: noted. Also flagging perf team for kernel-selection regressions (cc @sam @nina) in case fallback chain changes are contributing.
sam: will look at kernel selector diff; fallback frequency rising could indicate kernel mismatch under paged paths.
nina: we'll correlate kernel switch traces with telemetry to see if kernel churn aligns with paging storms.
maria: attaching full telemetry json and profiler outputs in the issue.
kevin: implementation note: prefer in-driver atomic epoch increment before allocator reuse; PT clear increments epoch, allocator checks epoch tag. Avoid extra syscalls.
chiara: for ROCm, add deterministic scatter list test that forces PT shuffle; helps CI detect regressions.
ajay: adding to eng-runtime agenda and we'll prioritize this for next sprint.
maria: thanks all. :thumbsup:
